title: One Piece Film: Strong World
notes: Canon status per Wikipedia: not canon. "Oda addressed the canonicity of the film in 2024 … He stated that he does not connect the films to his manga". Oda was executive producer/story writer per the article. TV prologue: episodes 426–429.

in_universe.label: between Thriller Bark and Sabaody (fan wiki)
in_universe.note: This movie would be chronologically set after the Thriller Bark Arc and before the Sabaody Archipelago Arc, as Brook is part of the Straw Hats and the whole crew remains together.

release.note: Wikipedia: Eventually, the film premiered on December 12, 2009. | released = {{Film date|2009|12|12}}

title: One Piece Film: Z
notes: Canon status: Wikipedia makes no canon claim; the One Piece article says the films "offer contradictions in both chronology and design that make them incompatible with a single continuity". TV prologue "Z's Ambition" = final four episodes of season 15.

in_universe.label: end of season 15 (after Fish-Man Island)
in_universe.note: The events of the film takes place near the end of the fifteenth season of the One Piece anime series during the "Z's Ambition" story arc, which serves as a prologue.

release.note: Wikipedia: The 12th One Piece film was released on December 15, 2012. | released = {{Film date|2012|12|15}}

title: One Piece Film: Gold
notes: World premiere July 15, 2016 (Emirates Palace, Abu Dhabi); Japan July 23, 2016 used as release_date. Canon status: no canon claim in Wikipedia. TV prologue: "Silver Mine" arc (season 18).

in_universe.label: after Dressrosa, before Zou
in_universe.note: It takes place after the Dressrosa Arc (Gild Tesoro stated that Luffy had beaten Donquixote Doflamingo and Sabo has the powers of the Mera Mera no Mi), and before the Zou Arc

release.note: Wikipedia: The film was released in Japan on July 23, 2016, by its distributor Toei Company … | released = {{film date|2016|7|15|Emirates Palace|2016|7|23|Japan}}

title: One Piece: Stampede
notes: Premiere August 1, 2019; Japan release August 9, 2019 used. Canon status: no canon claim in Wikipedia.

in_universe.label: start of season 20 (before Wano proper)
in_universe.note: Episodes 895 and 896 contain an original story arc, "Cidre Guild" which ties into the film One Piece: Stampede. … Other Supernovas make their way as, elsewhere, Buena Festa looks forward to a clash between Luffy and Douglas Bullet, leading to the events in One Piece: Stampede.

release.note: Wikipedia: The 14th One Piece film was released on August 9, 2019. | released = {{Film date|2019|08|01|premiere|2019|08|09|Japan}}

title: One Piece Film: Red
notes: Tokyo premiere July 22, 2022; Japan release August 6, 2022 used. Canon status: Wikipedia makes no canon claim; the One Piece Wiki says "while not canon". Wikipedia (List of One Piece films) says the upcoming Film: God Valley "will be the first canon One Piece movie", implying Red is not.
